parties: Edelweiss Asset Reconstruction Company Ltd; Parsvnath Developers Limited
headline: Edelweiss EARC discloses substantial shareholding in Parsvnath Developers under SEBI takeover regulations
sum: Edelweiss Asset Reconstruction Company filed a Regulation 29(2) disclosure with NSE regarding a substantial shareholding or takeover bid in Parsvnath Developers Limited. The disclosure under SEBI (SAST) Regulations 2011 triggers standard mandatory offer and public governance requirements for the real-estate developer.
implication: EARC's filing signals either acquisition of >25% stake or acquisition of board control; the acquirer must comply with open offer norms (Regulation 23 SAST) and appointment/disclosure of shareholding pattern per listing rules - structurally distinct from negotiated acquisition of entire company.
detail: Edelweiss Asset Reconstruction Company Ltd, a special-purpose vehicle for distressed asset recovery (typically set up by banks/SEBI), made a Regulation 29(2) disclosure to NSE regarding Parsvnath Developers Limited, a publicly-listed real estate company. The disclosure mechanism under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeover) Regulations 2011 is triggered when an acquirer crosses specified thresholds of shares or voting rights. The filing initiates public transparency and triggers mandatory offer requirements unless exemptions apply (e.g., open offer exemption for reconstruction of financially distressed companies).

structure.novel: Use of Asset Reconstruction Company to acquire control of listed real estate developer - typically ARCs focus on distressed debt; acquisition of equity control in real estate is less common and may signal strategic portfolio shift or debt-to-equity conversion strategy.
